plain.li: [arrive] I'll wait here for your answer.
[find,prospectors] Color in the pan, look at that.
[find,prospectors] Small, but it's silver all the same.
[find,prospectors] There's more where that came from, I can feel it.
[find,prospectors,theirHightech] The detector's singing, dig here.
[glean,gleaners] Good grain, and nobody's but ours now.
[glean,gleaners] They harvest clean here, there's little left.
[fire] Sit, there's room by the fire.
[fire] Warm hands and a full belly, what more is there?
[fire,pilgrims] Sing with us, if you know the words.
[fire,prospectors] Tomorrow's the day, we say that every night.
[fire,drovers] The cattle are quiet, so we can be.
[fire,gleaners] Our backs ache, but the sacks are fuller.
[arrive,rider] I'm to ride back with your answer.
[arrive,rider,theirLowtech] The elders sent me for your word.
[arrive,runner] Ran the whole way, can I sit?
[arrive,envoy] I'll stand here until your people have talked it over.
[arrive,herald] The lord's herald, at your service.
[arrive,driver,animals] Mind the beast, it bites strangers.
[arrive,driver,theirHightech] Long road, and every mile of it rough.
[arrive,family] We can sleep anywhere, we've had the practice.
[arrive,families] We're only passing through on our way home.
[arrive,travelers] The road's shut behind us and ahead.
[arrive,merchant] One boot. They left me one boot.
[arrive,exiles] We won't be any trouble.
[arrive,captive] Is this the colony they talk about?
[arrive,survivor] Water first, if you have it.
[arrive,pilgrims] Peace on this house.
[arrive,drovers] Keep your dogs in, would you?
[arrive,drovers,animals] Easy, easy now, stay together.
[arrive,herders] The animals smell water already.
[arrive,hunters] We'll keep clear of your fields.
[arrive,patrol] Seen anyone in uniform come through?
[arrive,stargazer] Clear sky tonight, if this holds.
[arrive,canvassers] I'm not with him.
[arrive,surveyors] Good level ground, this.
[arrive,salvagers] Most of what came down is plate steel, and some of it barely scorched.
[arrive,foreman] The river took everything but the stones.
[arrive,clerk] I'm sorry about the amount on the assessment.
[arrive,retinue] Make way for the lord's household.
[arrive,singer] I'll sing for my supper, if there's supper.
[arrive,fugitive] Is there somewhere I can sit where the road can't see me?
[arrive,elder] I came to hear it from your own mouths.
[arrive,tollman] The keeper's terms. Read them, I'll wait.
[arrive,smith] Don't mind the soot, it never comes off.
[arrive,smith,animals] The cart's empty, and it doesn't have to be.
[arrive,agent] My house buys from the good stops on this road.
[arrive,deserter] I'm not armed. I'm not anyone's soldier now.
[arrive,prospectors] There's color in these hills, mark my words.
[arrive,prospectors,night] Bring the lamps down to the water.
[arrive,prospector] No pan this time. Just me.
[arrive,winter] Cold enough to split stones out there.
[arrive,rain] Soaked through on the last mile.
[wait] Still waiting on an answer here.
[wait,night] I'll sleep by the wall, if nobody minds.
[wait,rider] They'll want to know what took so long.
[wait,family] The children can't sit still much longer.
[wait,envoy] I can wait as long as your council can talk.
[wait,pilgrims] We'll pray while we wait.
[wait,winter] Getting colder out here.
[wait,fugitive] Every rider on that road is looking for me.
[wait,elder] I have buried one boy this year. I can wait an hour.
[wait,smith] The widow's plow won't mend itself.
[wait,agent] The wagon can't wait all day.
[wait,deserter] If a patrol comes by, I wasn't here.
[stay] Thank you. We'll be gone at first light.
[stay,travelers] We'll pay you back when the road opens.
[stay,merchant] This goes in my ledger, and I don't forget my ledger.
[stay,stargazer] I'll be out watching the sky all night, come and look if you like.
[stay,fugitive] I'll keep out of the way. You won't know I'm here.
[stay,pilgrims] We'll make camp by the water, out of your way.
[stay,prospectors] We'll be down at the creek if you want us.
[pass] Don't mind us, we're just passing.
[pass,mourners] Slowly now. Keep the drum steady.
[pass,band] Keep walking, and don't stare at their walls.
[pass,retinue] Banners up. They're watching from the wall.
[pass,drovers] Keep them off the fields!
[pass,herders] Down to the water, all of you.
[pass,rider] He came this way. I'm sure of it.
[leave] Time I was going.
[leave,theirLowtech] If I go now I'll be home before the weather turns.
[leave,family] Come on. Pick up your things.
[leave,pilgrims] Stay well, and stay fed.
[leave,drovers] Up, all of you, it's a long road today.
[leave,herders] The rest has done them good.
[leave,fugitive] If anyone asks, you never saw me.
[leave,tollman] Back to the chain, then.
[leave,smith] Good steel's worth the walk.
[leave,prospectors] On to the next creek.
[leave,prospector] Next hill. There's always a next hill.
[arrive,preacher] I won't keep anyone long. Whoever wants to listen can listen.
[wait,preacher] There's no hurry. There never is.
[stay,preacher] A blanket is plenty. More than plenty.
[leave,preacher] Give away one thing. Just one, to start.
[arrive,digger] Straight out of the hill, this lot. Still smells of it.
[arrive,smuggler] Keep your voice down. It carries at night.
[wait,smuggler] Every lamp on that road is a guard's.
[arrive,bailiff] The creditors' list. I only read it out.
[arrive,housemaster] Forty years I've run this house. Forty.
[arrive,roadkeeper] The ice is singing today. That means it's holding.
[leave,roadkeeper] Back to the poles, then.
[arrive,delegates] We'll take turns asking, if that helps.
[arrive,gleaners] Only what's on the ground. We know how it's done.
[arrive,tinker] Pots mended, knives ground, and the news for nothing.
[arrive,orphan] I can fetch water. And wood. I'm stronger than I look.
[arrive,mother] I won't come in. I only wanted to see the place.
[leave,mother] Tell him... no. Never mind. Thank you.

warm.li: [arrive] Your people look well fed, that's a good sign.
[arrive,family] Is it all right if we sit, while the little one sleeps?
[arrive,pilgrims] We pray for every house on this road.
[wait] Whatever you decide, thank you for hearing me out.
[stay] You don't know what a roof for the night is worth.
[stay,family] They haven't slept dry in a week.
[arrive,elder] Your talker did right by both our families.
[stay,pilgrims] We'll sing for you tonight, if you'll let us.
[pass,mourners] Thank you for letting us pass.
[leave,stargazer] Look up now and then, it's worth it.

blunt.li: [arrive] Well? Who do I talk to?
[arrive,rider] I want an answer, and soon.
[wait] How long does a council take?
[arrive,tollman] Pay or don't. There are other gates.
[arrive,smith] Steel. As much as you can spare.
[stay] One night. We'll be gone before you're up.

cheerful.li: [arrive] Found you on the first try!
[arrive,runner] I didn't stop once, not once.
[arrive,prospectors] Today's the day, I can feel it in my boots!
[wait] Nice view from your gate, this.
[stay] A fire and a wall to sleep against, that's luxury.
[pass,drovers] Look at them go, best herd on the road!

gloomy.li: [arrive,travelers] We'd have died out there, simple as that.
[arrive,deserter] Three days without food. I stopped counting the miles.
[wait,fugitive] They'll find me, whatever you say.
[wait] I'll stand here till someone tells me otherwise.
[pass,mourners] It's a long road to bury someone.

cold.li: [arrive] I carry the message, nothing more.
[arrive,agent] I have other places on my list.
[wait,tollman] The board says what it says.
[wait] I'll note how long this took.
